SELECT t.tdm43_manl_id AS manl_id, t.tdm43_manl_org_id AS manl_org_id, t.tdm43_org_id AS org_id, t.tdm43_exct_id AS exct_id, t.tdm43_role_id AS role_id, t.tdm43_role_nm AS role_name, t.tdm43_task_id AS task_id, t.tdm43_task_nm AS task_name, t.tdm43_task_relate_detail_id AS task_relate_detail_id, t.tdm43_task_relate_duty_id AS task_relate_duty_id, t.tdm43_manl_duty_id AS manl_duty_id, t.tdm43_manl_cd AS manl_code, CASE WHEN t.tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t.tdm43_task_relate_detail_seq || '. ' || t.tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm END AS task_detail_add_seq, CASE WHEN t.tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t.tdm43_task_relate_duty_seq || '. ' || t.tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm END AS task_duty_add_seq, CASE WHEN t.tdm43_manl_cd IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE '(' || t.tdm43_manl_cd || ') ' || t.tdm43_check_item END AS check_item_add_code, CASE WHEN length(t.tdm43_check_how) > 300 THEN SUBSTR(t.tdm43_check_how,1,300)||'...' ELSE t.tdm43_check_how END AS check_how_limit, f_cdnm('CycleCode', t.tdm43_check_cycle_cd, t.tdm43_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS check_cycle_name, t.tdm43_check_evid_doc_nm AS check_evid_doc_name, CASE WHEN ( t.tdm43_start_date IS NULL OR t.tdm43_start_date <= COALESCE(t.std_date, f_today()) ) THEN false ELSE true END AS unuse_yn FROM ( SELECT tdm43_manl.* , tdm12_seq AS tdm43_task_relate_detail_seq , tdm13_seq AS tdm43_task_relate_duty_seq , tdm42_end_date AS std_date FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm43_manl ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id LEFT JOIN tdm12_task_relate_detail ON tdm12_task_relate_detail_id = tdm43_task_relate_detail_id LEFT JOIN tdm13_task_relate_duty ON tdm13_task_relate_duty_id = tdm43_task_relate_duty_id WHERE tdm42_manl_org_id = #{manlOrgId} AND COALESCE(tdm42_lock_yn,'false') = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(tdm43_manl_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) AS tdm43_manl_id , tdm42_manl_org_id AS tdm43_manl_org_id , tdm42_company_id AS tdm43_company_id , tdm42_org_id AS tdm43_org_id , tdm42_exct_id AS tdm43_exct_id , tdm42_role_id AS tdm43_role_id , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm43_role_nm , tdm41_task_id AS tdm43_task_id , tdm10_task_nm AS tdm43_task_nm , tdm41_task_relate_detail_id AS tdm43_task_relate_detail_id , tdm12_content AS tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm , tdm41_task_relate_duty_id AS tdm43_task_relate_duty_id , tdm13_content AS tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm , tdm43_check_item , tdm43_check_cycle_cd , tdm43_check_month , tdm43_check_evid_type , tdm43_check_evid_etc , tdm43_check_how , tdm43_ref_basis , tdm43_start_date , tdm41_manl_duty_id AS tdm43_manl_duty_id , tdm43_first_reg_emp_id , tdm43_manl_cd , tdm43_upd_nm , tdm43_upd_date , tdm43_check_evid_doc_nm , tdm43_ceo_duty_cd , tdm43_exct_duty_cd , tdm43_import_level_cd , tdm43_exct_duty_map , tdm12_seq AS tdm43_task_relate_detail_seq , tdm13_seq AS tdm43_task_relate_duty_seq , tdm42_end_date AS std_date FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm42_role_id INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM tdm41_manl_duty INNER JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm41_task_id INNER JOIN tdm12_task_relate_detail ON tdm12_task_relate_detail_id = tdm41_task_relate_detail_id INNER JOIN tdm13_task_relate_duty ON tdm13_task_relate_duty_id = tdm41_task_relate_duty_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = tdm42_manl_job_id AND tdm41_role_id = tdm42_role_id AND tdm44_org_id = tdm42_org_id ) tdm41 ON TRUE LEFT JOIN tdm43_manl ON ( tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id AND tdm43_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id ) WHERE tdm42_manl_org_id = #{manlOrgId} AND COALESCE(tdm42_lock_yn,'false') = 'false' ) t WHERE 1=1 AND CONCAT(tdm43_task_nm, tdm43_task_relate_detail_nm, tdm43_task_relate_duty_nm, tdm43_manl_cd, tdm43_check_item) ILIKE #{searchText}
AND COALESCE(tdm43_start_date, '1999-01-01'::date) <= COALESCE(std_date, f_today())
AND COALESCE(tdm43_start_date, '1999-01-01'::date) > COALESCE(std_date, f_today())
ORDER BY tdm43_task_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , tdm43_task_relate_detail_seq, tdm43_task_relate_duty_seq, tdm43_manl_cd
